title: Argumentative Essay: School Uniforms
instruction: Argue for or against mandatory school uniforms in public schools. Provide at least three reasons with supporting evidence.

title: Descriptive Essay: A Place That Inspires Me
instruction: Describe a place that makes you feel inspired. Use sensory details to bring the location to life.

title: Narrative: A Challenge I Overcame
instruction: Write about a difficult challenge you faced and how you overcame it. Reflect on what you learned.

title: Formal Letter: Letter to the Editor
instruction: Write a letter to the editor of your local newspaper expressing your opinion on a community issue.

title: Book Review: My Favorite Novel
instruction: Write a review of a novel you have read recently. Include a brief summary, analysis of themes, and your recommendation.

title: Argumentative: Is Technology Making Us Lonelier?
instruction: Argue whether technology brings people closer together or drives them apart.

title: Report: Analyzing a Historical Event
instruction: Write a report analyzing the causes and effects of a significant historical event.

title: Persuasive: Should Animal Testing Be Banned?
instruction: Write a persuasive essay arguing for or against animal testing in scientific research.

title: Comparative Essay: Two Political Systems
instruction: Compare and contrast two different political systems, discussing their strengths and weaknesses.

title: Analytical: Theme Analysis in Literature
instruction: Analyze the central theme of a literary work you have studied. Use textual evidence to support your analysis.

title: Formal Email: Job Application
instruction: Write a formal job application email for a position you would like to have. Include your qualifications and motivation.

title: Argumentative: Climate Action Responsibility
instruction: Argue who bears the primary responsibility for combating climate change: governments, corporations, or individuals.

title: Research Proposal: A Scientific Question
instruction: Write a research proposal for a scientific investigation. Include research question, hypothesis, methodology, and expected outcomes.

title: Critical Essay: Evaluating a Theory
instruction: Critically evaluate a scientific or philosophical theory, discussing its strengths, limitations, and implications.

title: Synthesis Essay: Multiple Sources
instruction: Synthesize information from at least three sources on a topic of your choice. Present a coherent argument integrating multiple perspectives.

title: Discursive: The Pros and Cons of Globalization
instruction: Discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of globalization in the modern world.

title: Reflective: My Educational Journey
instruction: Reflect on your educational journey so far. Discuss key experiences that have shaped your learning and personal growth.

title: Summary: Condensing a Complex Text
instruction: Write a concise summary of a complex text, capturing the main arguments and key evidence without personal commentary.

title: Creative: Short Story with a Twist
instruction: Write a short story that ends with an unexpected twist. Focus on character development and atmosphere.

title: Persuasive Speech: Text
instruction: Write the text of a persuasive speech on a topic you care deeply about. Use rhetorical devices to strengthen your argument.

title: Compare and Contrast: Two Poems
instruction: Compare and contrast two poems on a similar theme, analyzing their use of language, imagery, and poetic devices.

title: Explain: A Scientific Process
instruction: Explain a scientific process or natural phenomenon in a way that is accessible to a general audience.

title: Autobiographical: A Defining Moment
instruction: Write about a defining moment in your life that changed your perspective or direction.

title: Critical Review: A Film or Documentary
instruction: Write a critical review of a film or documentary, discussing its strengths, weaknesses, and overall impact.
